# gitdone

> A percent done you can defend: strict and weighted completion from one plan file and one status table, with every claim held to git. A row is Live when a commit on the default branch or a merged pull request says so, and a commit that would make the view lie is refused. Python standard library only.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArtJack/gitdone/main/README.md): what it is, install, quickstart, what it can do on your machine
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArtJack/gitdone/main/AGENTS.md): for agents that use it and agents that change it
